title: Asymptotic Analysis of Gradient Mapping-type Stationarity Measure for the Sum of Nonconvex Nonsmooth Functions and Applications to Proximal Gradient-type Algorithms
summary: We propose a gradient mapping-type stationarity measure for the sum of two possibly nonsmooth nonconvex functions. Under suitable regularity assumptions, we show that Fréchet or proximal stationarity can be characterized through asymptotic vanishing of the proposed measure along some convergent sequence. We also establish analogous asymptotic results for a smoothing-based variant of the measure, which enables us to combine the proposed framework with smoothing techniques developed for nonsmooth optimization.
